claims.extracted_source_fact: The historical rules module defines easy/normal/hard difficulty, playing/victory/defeat phases, word blocks, placed stability, feedback variants, serializable state, and a canonical completion shape.
Historical presets vary time limit, drop speed, maximum errors, stability costs/gains, and passive decay.
Historical state creation filters empty terms, defaults to normal, creates ordered blocks for the first sentence, starts playing at stability 100, and zeros progress/errors/score/attempts/time.
claims.interpretation: This is a historical initial state.

claims.extracted_source_fact: Historically, selecting the expected block advances progress, score, correct count, and stable placements; a wrong selection adds an unstable placement, error, and stability loss and may defeat at the preset limit.
claims.interpretation: Sentence-order block placement was the historical learning loop.

claims.extracted_source_fact: Historical ticks add elapsed time, decay stability with a 250 ms clamp, and defeat on timeout or zero stability.
claims.interpretation: These are historical pressure rules only.
